title: Guardian Overseer — 2026-04-30
markdown:
# Guardian Overseer — 2026-04-30

**Status: All Clear.** 5 jobs healthy, 99.7% success rate, 0 failures in last 24h, 0 skips.

## Job Summary

| Job | Schedule | Runs (24h) | Success Rate | Model | Notes |
|-----|----------|------------|--------------|-------|-------|
| health-check | */5 min | 286 | 98.6% | haiku | 4 historical spawn-errors (March); last 24h clean |
| degradation-digest | every 4h | 6 | 100% | haiku | Healthy |
| state-integrity-check | every 6h | 3 (young) | 100% | haiku | View accumulation issue (see below) |
| guardian-pulse | every 8h | 3 (young) | 100% | haiku | Only 1 full day of data |
| session-continuity-check | every 4h | 6 | 100% | haiku | Healthy |

## Issues Found

### 1. View Accumulation — state-integrity-check
This job has created **19 private views** since April 14, with no cleanup of old ones. One run on 2026-04-29T19:03 created **two views in the same minute** (double-create bug). Only the latest view is useful; the rest are dead weight in the views list. The job should clean up previous versions when creating new ones.

### 2. No Handoff Notes from Any Guardian Job
All five jobs have `lastHandoff: null`. The overseer has no cross-run memory — it cannot detect trends, compare findings run-to-run, or build context over time. Each overseer run starts blind. For meaningful trend analysis, at minimum `health-check`, `state-integrity-check`, and `guardian-pulse` should write structured handoff notes.

## Non-Issues

- **health-check 98.6% rate**: The 4 failures are from March spawn-errors, not recent. Last 24h is 100% clean.
- **Model allocation**: All jobs use haiku — correct for monitoring workloads. No over-allocation.
- **Coverage**: Health, degradation, integrity, pulse, continuity, and overseer are all covered. No blind spots observed.
- **Attention queue**: One item (`ci-release-token-missing`) is marked DONE — no active concerns.

## Recommendations

1. **Fix state-integrity-check view cleanup** — delete the previous view before creating the new one, or use an update (PUT) to overwrite in place.
2. **Add handoff notes** — at minimum health-check and state-integrity-check should write a one-paragraph handoff summarizing their findings each run.
